description: Use when an agent must check a transaction before accepting or relaying funds: screens its direct parties (sender, recipient, contracts, token Transfer parties on Base; accounts and token owners on Solana) against OFAC SDN wallet addresses. Input: tx, network (eip155:8453 default, or solana). Output: verdict, parties, roles, listed yes/no, SDN entity, programs, tx status, list date. Bad formats refused before payment. Not a legal determination. Example: ?tx=0x… Price: $0.009 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

tx.description: Transaction hash (0x…, Base) or signature (base58, Solana)

name: sanctions_tx
title: OFAC transaction screening: every party of a Base (or Solana) transaction against the SDN wallet list
